args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted.
Flagged (6), reason other (likely duplicates): r01/r07, r05/r06 and r02/r08. In each pair, the two runs match exactly on all three check values (rigid invariance, closure, plane sections). They also match on every strain-rate summary: REGR peak and its position, growth-zone length, and flank difference and its position. Their final settings and kept remedies match too. The only difference is r02/r08's step count (5 vs 7). Separate roots would not give the same velocity, strain-rate and curvature numbers, so each pair looks like one measurement reported twice. We can't tell which root it belongs to.
Cleared (2): r03 and r04. Both pass all checks, all summaries have |z| < 2, neither duplicates another run, and r04's one kept remedy (registration) is the normal path.
What the flagged runs share: none fails a check or is a strain-rate outlier. The problem is duplicated reports, which points to a bookkeeping or run-assignment fault upstream, not to the kinematics. The source movies for these 6 runs should be checked before they are reported.
